subject: reasoning
question: Arpan starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only, unless specified)
solution:
Given:

Arpan starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards East.

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/311285fa96d823c7f04bf7fb725199c32f95199f70fe0c1aa0431a2212c52e72.png] 

Thus, Arpan should drive 4 km (12 km - 8 km) in the south direction​ in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
